# OFATCE Global Limited

> Nigerian engineering services firm delivering specialized Oil & Gas solutions and Audiovisual & Networking services. Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Port Harcourt with a Lagos office.

OFATCE Global Limited operates two business lines under one trusted brand:

- **Oil & Gas Solutions** — exploration & production support, infrastructure & project management, maintenance & operational safety, and IoT-enabled technology integration across upstream, midstream, and downstream operations.
- **Audiovisual & Networking Solutions** — enterprise networking, structured cabling, audio-visual systems, video conferencing (Cisco, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Polycom, Logitech), residential and commercial automation, and Security Operations Center (SOC) services.

The company has delivered 250+ projects since 2006 with 99.99% system reliability, serving banking, energy, corporate, and government clients across Nigeria.
